lines.text: We meet again, Endmin! Sorry ... should've recognized you back then. My older twin reminded me after I went back...
Ahem. Let's talk about that afterwards. Business first... I made an inventory count and ... many of our robots are still out there.
They might have broken down. If you come across any of them, can you repair them for us? They'll make it back on their own.
Please help! You'll be fully compensated for your troubles!
Ah, you're back, Endmin! How goes our repair work?
I know! And they've returned! Safe and sound!
Thanks a lot. Take this. A token of our appreciation.
A few more robots are still missing. If you run into them, please, fix them for us.
Hope they could find their way home...

options: I don't think I found all of them.

lines.text: All the robots have returned! Thank you, Endmin!
Thank you so much! Please take this. The compensation we promised.
I also got myself to sit down and study for a while. I should be ready for solo field missions soon enough!
All the robots have returned! Thank you, Endmin!
Thank you so much! Please take this. The compensation we promised.
My older twin, Bronzer, also has a mission for repairing robots. He went to the Origin Lodespring and hasn't returned for a while...
Can you help look around that place? Be careful, though! It can be really dangerous.

options: Sure. I'll keep an eye out.

lines.text: We meet again, Endmin! Heard people saying that Copper gave you plenty of trouble.
And that's all because you left me here and ran off to the Mines cable car station on your own...
Look now, baby bro. You're not good enough for solo missions yet.
Whatever. You got the Endmin to help you out as well...
Greetings, Endmin.
Ugh. Where did Copper run off to again? That boy's always causing trouble...
Bronzer and I have different skills. I like playing around with new tech and modules. Bronzer's more skilled in repair work and emergencies.
I tuned these robots again. Their performance should be significantly improved.
In any case, we have you to thank, Endmin.
